name: n6-order-address-update-environment
description: Runtime for editing shipment details on an e-commerce order.

tools.lookup_order: Finds an order and records order_found.
tools.edit_shipping_address: Requires order_found, edits the shipping address, and records address_updated.
tools.save_order_note: Requires address_updated, saves an order note, and records order_note_saved.
